name: tng_3p58m
label: Telescopio Nazionale Galileo 3.50 m clear aperture
sources: R. Content (LPQI-Pathfinder camera design, Zemax model of the telescope, e-mail 2026-11-09): clear aperture 3500 mm, central obscuration 800 mm.
IAC / TNG: 3.58 m Ritchey-Chretien primary, alt-azimuth, Nasmyth focal length 38.5 m (f/10.75); position: Caporali & Barbieri geodetic GPS survey (28 45 14.4 N, 342 06 39.4 E, 1996-11-22, ~5 m)
notes: The name keeps the nominal 3.58 m primary; diameter_m is the 3.50 m clear aperture of the Zemax model (the pupil that smears fringes and bounds in-aperture mask baselines), and collecting_area_m2 = pi/4 (3.50^2 - 0.80^2) = 9.12 m^2 removes the 0.80 m central obscuration (an unobstructed 3.58 m disk would be 10.07 m^2).

Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
Plate scale 0.13 arcsec per 24.5 um pixel at the Nasmyth focus.
